exposure: Mode of delivery (prelabor cesarean, vaginal delivery)
outcome: Apgar score less than 7 in the fifth minute
cohort: Term births in a public teaching hospital from 2013 to 2020; 100 cases with Apgar score < 7 in the fifth minute and 190 controls with Apgar score >= 7
finding: Prelabor cesarean section was associated with a reduced risk of low Apgar score in the fifth minute, while nulliparity, male fetal sex, less than six prenatal visits, abnormal cardiotocography, and prolonged rupture of membranes were associated with an increased risk.
mod_finding: Prelabor cesarean section was associated with a reduced risk of low Apgar score in the fifth minute.
